patterns.name: Liquid Glass
patterns.definition: A translucent, dynamic functional layer separates controls from content.
patterns.guardrail: Use sparingly for toolbars or navigation; provide opaque fallback and test contrast.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Material 3 Expressive
patterns.definition: Shape, scale, color, containment and motion reinforce hierarchy.
patterns.guardrail: Use meaningful emphasis, not arbitrary saturated colors.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Progressive blur
patterns.definition: Gradually reduce detail behind a control or edge rather than blur every surface.
patterns.guardrail: Test readable content and contrast; opaque fallback.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Content-first / calm UI
patterns.definition: Reduce permanent chrome and show secondary actions on demand.
patterns.guardrail: Keep frequent actions discoverable; do not hide critical status.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Variable typography
patterns.definition: Adjust type axes or styles for hierarchy and expressive emphasis.
patterns.guardrail: Maintain readability, zoom and predictable layout.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Semantic tokens and modes
patterns.definition: Map design intent to tokens that change across themes or contexts.
patterns.guardrail: Avoid per-component hardcoded values; test contrast per mode.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Anchored popover
patterns.definition: A transient nonmodal surface opens adjacent to its invoker.
patterns.guardrail: Use fallback positioning and appropriate keyboard/focus semantics.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Responsive overflow toolbar
patterns.definition: Move secondary commands into an overflow control as space shrinks.
patterns.guardrail: Preserve accessible command names and shortcuts; don't hide primary tasks.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Origin-aware transitions
patterns.definition: Open from a visible source to communicate where the destination came from.
patterns.guardrail: Do not delay navigation or use motion as the sole cue.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Contextual hint / hover card
patterns.definition: Expose explanatory preview linked to an object without leaving the page.
patterns.guardrail: Also support focus or explicit activation; dismiss without trapping input.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: State-preserving reparenting
patterns.definition: Move a component between surfaces while preserving interaction state when supported.
patterns.guardrail: Check browser support; test focused inputs, scroll and media.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Gesture-enabled bottom sheet
patterns.definition: A surface slides up from the bottom; optionally drag to resize or dismiss.
patterns.guardrail: Provide explicit close, focus management and keyboard operation.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Inline editing
patterns.definition: Switch a displayed value to an editor in the same place.
patterns.guardrail: Save/cancel and validation; preserve focus and handle conflicts.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Expandable row
patterns.definition: Reveal related details directly below an item.
patterns.guardrail: Use explicit expand control and accessible expanded state.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Contextual batch actions
patterns.definition: Reveal relevant actions when one or more items are selected.
patterns.guardrail: Show selection count and clear selection; confirm risky operations.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Instant filtering
patterns.definition: Apply each filter immediately while the user explores.
patterns.guardrail: Keep results stable and announce change without overwhelming screen readers.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Apply-to-filter
patterns.definition: Stage filter choices and apply them together.
patterns.guardrail: Show unsaved changes and active filters; provide reset.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Editable combobox
patterns.definition: Text entry and selectable suggestions share one control.
patterns.guardrail: Follow APG focus and keyboard contract; don't use arbitrary menu roles.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Treegrid
patterns.definition: Tabular properties combined with expandable hierarchy.
patterns.guardrail: Use only when hierarchy and columns are both essential; test keyboard traversal.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Actionable empty state
patterns.definition: Differentiate no items, no matches and unavailable data.
patterns.guardrail: Offer relevant recovery, reset or creation action; no fake data.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Skeleton loading
patterns.definition: Reserve expected content geometry while data loads.
patterns.guardrail: Use busy/status semantics and timeout; static alternative.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Shared-element transition
patterns.definition: Preserve object identity across layouts with coordinated geometry.
patterns.guardrail: Use stable identity; preserve focus independently of visual snapshots.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Element-scoped view transition
patterns.definition: Limit snapshot transitions to a region instead of the entire page.
patterns.guardrail: Use fallback; browser support is not universally verified.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Physics-based spring
patterns.definition: Motion responds to stiffness, damping and interruption.
patterns.guardrail: Avoid excess oscillation; match semantic urgency and reduced-motion settings.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Shape morphing
patterns.definition: Interpolate compatible geometry to communicate transformation.
patterns.guardrail: Maintain recognizable identity; avoid motion-only status signals.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Scroll-linked animation
patterns.definition: Animation progress follows scroll or visibility rather than elapsed time.
patterns.guardrail: No essential content hidden by animation; reduced motion and support fallback.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Scroll-triggered animation
patterns.definition: A visibility/scroll threshold triggers a time-based sequence.
patterns.guardrail: Distinguish from scroll-linked motion; check implementation support.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Staggered reveal
patterns.definition: Offset the entrance of related elements to establish sequence.
patterns.guardrail: Keep total delay small; avoid delaying access to controls.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Gesture-driven motion
patterns.definition: Coordinate drag movement and spring return or settle.
patterns.guardrail: Add keyboard and non-drag pointer alternative; support cancel.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Discrete entry/exit transitions
patterns.definition: Animate entering and leaving top-layer or display states with suitable CSS.
patterns.guardrail: Check @starting-style and transition-behavior support and fallback.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Stateful animated mascot
patterns.definition: Avatar communicates lifecycle through expression, pose and text.
patterns.guardrail: Don't infer completion from animation; pause and reduced motion.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Agent entry point
patterns.definition: Expose an agent in the context of a task, capability or workspace.
patterns.guardrail: Clearly communicate scope and limitations.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Human approval gate
patterns.definition: Pause before a consequential action and show an understandable request.
patterns.guardrail: Show scope and consequence; allow reject or edit; never treat silence as consent.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Progressive AI explanation
patterns.definition: Provide concise explanation and deeper evidence on demand.
patterns.guardrail: Separate verified sources from model estimates; don't fabricate rationale.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Calibrated uncertainty display
patterns.definition: Communicate limitations or uncertainty when it helps the user decide.
patterns.guardrail: Avoid arbitrary percentages or unwarranted precision.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: AI feedback and correction
patterns.definition: Users can correct, reject or refine an output.
patterns.guardrail: Explain what feedback affects; make correction actionable.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Graceful AI failure / handoff
patterns.definition: Return control when automation cannot complete the task.
patterns.guardrail: Show what failed and what remains; preserve user work.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Declarative generative UI
patterns.definition: Agent emits structured UI intent for a trusted host component catalog.
patterns.guardrail: Validate schema; restrict actions and keep host permissions authoritative.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Scoped agent permissions
patterns.definition: Grant access to a specific action or resource instead of unrestricted authority.
patterns.guardrail: Make duration and revocation clear; reapprove scope changes.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Streaming response and activity
patterns.definition: Show incremental results and meaningful activity as work progresses.
patterns.guardrail: Don't invent internal thought or progress; support interruption and recovery.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Brushing and linking
patterns.definition: Selecting a range or marks in one view highlights related items in another.
patterns.guardrail: Make linked effects visible and reversible; provide non-drag alternatives.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Cross-filtering
patterns.definition: Selection in one chart filters another representation.
patterns.guardrail: Show active filters and reset; distinguish filtering from highlighting.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Details on demand
patterns.definition: Reveal exact values or record-level details when requested.

patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Overview + focus
patterns.definition: Show global context while enabling a focused subset or detail.

patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Small multiples
patterns.definition: Repeat the same chart design for comparable categories.
patterns.guardrail: Use comparable scales and labels; avoid excessive panels.

patterns.name: Multi-page dashboard
patterns.definition: Partition questions into coordinated dashboard surfaces.
patterns.guardrail: Avoid duplicating inconsistent filters and preserve contextual state.
patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Dashboard density management
patterns.definition: Choose information amount and grouping for the user's decision.

patterns.classification: documented concept or applied synthesis; not measured 2026 adoption

patterns.name: Separate organizational contexts

patterns.name: Object collections and facets
patterns.definition: Separate ownership, access, object type, origin and activity from hierarchy.

patterns.name: Composable page / block editor

patterns.name: Per-block table width and fit
patterns.definition: Normal, Flexible, Full width and readability/equal columns. Do not infer exact sizes.

patterns.name: Contextual AI and scoped edits

patterns.guardrail: Test scope, undo/review, permission, cancellation, errors, keyboard.

patterns.name: Verified recurring updates

patterns.name: Intelligent UI / generated interface

patterns.guardrail: Test fallback text, state reload, control semantics, contrast and reduced motion.

patterns.name: Interactive visualization vs persistent app
patterns.definition: Visualization is generally snapshot; sites are a distinct option. Show data context, labels, accessibility and simpler fallback on failure.
patterns.guardrail: Test keyboard, data table, units, blank/loading/error and export.

patterns.name: Unified content search

patterns.name: Customizable mobile navigation

patterns.name: Contextual collaboration

patterns.name: artifact lifecycle

patterns.name: fine grained design

patterns.name: project context

patterns.classification: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

patterns.name: installable artifact

patterns.name: interactive connectors

patterns.name: persistent agent

patterns.name: avatar states

patterns.name: execution visibility

patterns.name: pages

patterns.name: recurring

patterns.name: canvas edit

patterns.name: adaptive generative ui

patterns.name: simulation

patterns.name: document transform

patterns.name: study space

patterns.name: three region shell
